description: http CONNECT as Node 22: a server emits connect (req, socket, head), the socket paused until something reads it, with the bytes after the head and never request, closes the socket with no status when nothing listens, and leaves the tunnel to the program after a FIN; a ClientRequest with method CONNECT emits connect (res, socket, head) for any status, not response, the socket paused and out of its agent, sends the head Node sends, and closes with no listener
